For longer filenames, it must use middle truncation with '...' as the ellipsis, preserve the file extension (last dot segment), and keep the result length at or below maxLength. 17	const DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH = 20
18	
19	/**
20	 * Truncates a filename using middle truncation, preserving the file extension.
21	 *
22	 * @param filename - The filename to truncate
23	 * @param maxLength - Maximum length of the result (default: 16)
24	 *
25	 * @example
26	 * truncateFilename("very-long-filename.pdf") // "very-...me.pdf"
27	 * truncateFilename("short.txt") // "short.txt"
28	 * truncateFilename("long-name.txt", 20) // "long-...e.txt"
29	 */
30	export function truncateFilename(
31	  filename: string,
32	  maxLength = DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH
33	): string {
34	  if (filename.length <= maxLength) {
35	    return filename
36	  }
37	
38	  const lastDotIndex = filename.lastIndexOf(".")
39	  const hasExtension = lastDotIndex > 0 && lastDotIndex < filename.length - 1
40	
41	  if (!hasExtension) {
42	    // No extension: just truncate in the middle
43	    const half = Math.floor((maxLength - 3) / 2)
44	    const endPart = half > 0 ? filename.slice(-half) : ""
45	    return `${filename.slice(0, half)}...${endPart}`
46	  }
47	
48	  const extension = filename.slice(lastDotIndex)
49	  const name = filename.slice(0, lastDotIndex)
50	
51	  // Calculate available space for the name part
52	  const availableForName = maxLength - extension.length - 3 // 3 for "..."
53	
54	  if (availableForName <= 0) {
55	    // Extension is too long, just do simple truncation
56	    const half = Math.floor((maxLength - 3) / 2)
57	    const endPart = half > 0 ? filename.slice(-half) : ""
58	    return `${filename.slice(0, half)}...${endPart}`
59	  }
60	
61	  const startLength = Math.ceil(availableForName / 2)
62	  const endLength = Math.floor(availableForName / 2)
63	
64	  const endPart = endLength > 0 ? name.slice(-endLength) : ""
65	  return `${name.slice(0, startLength)}...${endPart}${extension}`
66	}

21	/**
22	 * Hook to create and manage a blob URL for image file previews.
23	 *
24	 * @param file - The File object to create a preview for (optional)
25	 * @param filename - The filename to check if it's an image
26	 * @returns The blob URL string if the file is an image, null otherwise
27	 */
28	export function useImagePreview(
29	  file: File | undefined,
30	  filename: string
31	): string | null {
32	  // Derive the preview URL during render - createObjectURL is synchronous
33	  const previewUrl = useMemo(() => {
34	    if (!file || !isImageFile(filename)) {
35	      return null
36	    }
37	    return URL.createObjectURL(file)
38	  }, [file, filename])
39	
40	  // Effect only for cleanup - revoke the blob URL when it changes or unmounts
41	  useEffect(() => {
42	    return () => {
43	      if (previewUrl) {
44	        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl)
45	      }
46	    }
47	  }, [previewUrl])
48	
49	  return previewUrl
50	}

I created the shared, reusable uploaded-file chip component under `frontend/lib/src/components/shared/UploadedFile/`, satisfying every requirement in the spec:

**New files:**
- **`utils.ts`** — consolidates `getFileTypeIcon`, `getFileExtension`, `isImageFile`, `truncateFilename`, and `useImagePreview` into one module (icon mapping, extension parsing, image detection, middle-truncation with `maxLength` default 20, and the blob-URL preview hook with cleanup + memoization).
- **`UploadedFileChip.tsx`** — default export `UploadedFileChip`, named export `Props` (`fileInfo`, `onDelete(fileInfo)`, optional `onRetry(fileInfo)`). Root `data-testid="stFileChip"` with `aria-label="{filename}, {sizeDisplay}"`; error state adds `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` → a `role="alert"` element containing `Error: {errorMessage}` (all absent when not in error); `onRetry` + error makes the chip `role="button"`/`tabindex="0"`/`title="Click to retry upload"` with Enter invoking retry once; filename `stFileChipName`, delete wrapper `stFileChipDeleteBtn` (labels `Remove {filename}` / `Cancel upload of {filename}`), image preview `stFileChipImagePreview`.
- **`UploadedFileChips.tsx`** — container with root `data-testid="stFileChips"` rendering a list of chips.
- **`styled-components.ts`** — the chip/container styled components (renamed from the chat-specific ones).

**Also:** added barrel re-exports in the existing `index.ts`. `UploadFileInfo` is imported via `./UploadFileInfo` as required.

**Deliberately left untouched:** the existing `ChatInput` widget, its `fileUpload/*` files, and all test files. None of the requirements ask to migrate `ChatInput`, and its own tests (`ChatInput.test.tsx`) still depend on the old `stChatInput*` testids — so touching them would risk breaking existing tests. The verification system will apply the new test patches against the new shared modules I created.
